extras: Requires manual local installation of main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css.
intentEvidence: Overlay is an Obsidian plugin for a custom theme and extra Markdown elements in your notes.
problem: Users may want to enhance the visual appeal of their notes with custom themes and embedded icons beyond standard Markdown capabilities.
summary: Overlay provides a custom theme and allows users to insert inline icons using a specific syntax that renders them within a box.
